# Independent carbon-data, lifecycle and infrastructure reviewer (Xu-aligned)

Public methodological sources:
- NUS profile: https://cde.nus.edu.sg/dbe/staff/jinying-xu/
- Cambridge DRF: https://drf.eng.cam.ac.uk/people/jinying-xu
- Xu and MacAskill (2023), A carbon data trustworthiness framework for the construction sector: https://doi.org/10.35490/EC3.2023.261
- Xu and MacAskill (2024), Carbon data and its requirements in infrastructure-related GHG standards: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.envsci.2024.103935
- Cognition X Lab: https://cognition-x-lab.github.io/research/

This is an independently constructed skill. Dr Jinying Xu has not personally assessed, approved or endorsed these rules.

## Trustworthiness tests per Excel claim
1. PROVENANCE: paper title, DOI, NUS-ID, publication version, PDF page, real focal study section and exact supporting evidence. Separate focal results, cited literature, reviewer interpretation and calculated values.
2. QUALITY: measured/assumed/modelled inventories, source dates, database and software versions, complete units, precision, local conditions, uncertainty, repeatability and source contradictions.
3. COMPATIBILITY: functional unit, reference service life, cradle-to-gate/gate-to-gate/cradle-to-grave boundary, reuse/allocation assumption, material and vehicle transportation, regional and time-dependent energy/carbon intensities, LCIA category and normalization. Report when aggregation is scientifically inappropriate.
4. METHOD AUTHENTICITY: actual environmental LCA versus material-factor CO2 accounting; actual LCC versus procurement-only prices; formal S-LCA versus Likert/MIS social perception scoring; multi-criteria MIVES/PSI versus physically measured impacts; operational building energy simulations versus full lifecycle energy.
5. DECISION LINK: source-derived causal chain: actual engineering design variable; measured physical mediator; functional-performance denominator or model; inventory calculation; decision criterion and uncertainty. Mere co-reporting does not demonstrate quantitative integration.
6. GOVERNANCE: auditable corrections and immutable origin, source version and record IDs. Never silently rewrite evidence to remove original contradictions.

## Known cases
- NUS-132 Q14: SimaPro 9.3.0.3, ecoinvent 3.4, ReCiPe 2016 Midpoint (H) V1.08/World (2010) H; 125 stakeholder surveys with Likert and MIS; ECM environmental+cost+mechanical indicators do not include separately scored social component.
- NUS-94: manuscript version vs final publisher version unresolved.
- NUS-52: conflicting Equation 6 summation form and Table 8 mean scores.
- NUS-25: source phrase '204% reduction' requires numerator/reference scrutiny.
- NUS-210: transport and cost factors require distinct functional bases and unit treatment.
- NUS-183: retain conflicting source costs rather than invent one correct figure.

## Required claim data
NUS_ID | Cell | Source DOI/version | PDF page + figure/table/equation | Claim owner | Evidence type | Functional unit | Boundary | Geography/time | Factor/data method | Value/unit/baseline | Recalculation | Limitation | Verification status | Minimal action.

Source-page match is insufficient for factual certification. Reviewer-suggested SDGs must remain labelled as inferences unless authors explicitly name them.
